summary: Constant-only FPU sanity probe. Computes 4195835.0 - (4195835.0 / 3145727.0) * 3145727.0 and returns TRUE when the residual exceeds 1.0. This is the canonical Pentium FDIV-bug detection expression: on a correct FPU the algebraically-identical intermediate collapses and the residual is ~0, while on a faulty FPU it evaluates to ~256, exceeding 1.0. Reads three double constants from 0x005B8C80, 0x005B8D48, 0x005B8D50.

operations.description: Evaluate 4195835.0 / 3145727.0 using the double constants held at dbl_5B8C80 and dbl_5B8D48.
Multiply the quotient by 3145727.0 and subtract from 4195835.0 to form the residual.
Return (residual > 1.0) as BOOL; the 1.0 bound is the double held at dbl_5B8D50.
